market_summary: Across all six asset classes, the market is navigating the Asian chop session (02:30 UTC), triggering hard automation session blocks. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) exhibit heavy bearish CVD divergence after prior impulse waves into resistance, while FX majors (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and US100 consolidate tightly inside their respective Value Areas around flat session VWAPs. BTCUSD has broken below Value Area Low, but lacks yellow RVOL > 2.0 confirmation and is extended against its lower ATR band with an intrabar sweep of session lows. Complete capital preservation via HOLD across all instruments is enforced.
